snippet.title: Broken Ranks: The Other Side - Free Content Update Trailer | MMORPG
snippet.description:
✨ Step into the events of Broken Ranks: The Other Side ✨

Instead of more typical heroic deeds, you’ll get in the middle of an espionage mission where physical battles won’t be the only clashes you’ll face… Dive into mystery, creeping shadows, and the daily grind in the enemy’s uniform. For now, you're an Utorian recruit, but remember... this isn’t just a way to understand their world from the inside. It’s also an internal struggle against temptation. No one knows what will happen when you stare into the eyes of the enemy harder than ever before…

⚔️ Broken Ranks: The Other Side - AVAILABLE NOW ⚔️
https://brokenranks.com/en/tos/
Prepare. Breathe deep. Take up the challenge.

📜 In The Other Side, a major storyline-oriented update to Broken Ranks, an indie MMORPG inspired by world classic RPGs, a dangerous game of smoke and mirrors awaits you. You’ll become a rank and file recruit of the Utorian army, learn about the everyday life of the soldiers, the chain of command, and a complicated network of relationships and ambitions that may become an opportunity… or your doom.
